title: Down the Sheep Track
description: The track goes down between two hills that close over it
like a book, and the greenwood ends the way a sentence
ends: mid-thought, on a step, in the dark.
Below the hill the stone begins in earnest. What the map
room drew as a line is, from inside it, a corridor of
small decisions -- which side of the drop, which seam to
trust, when the torch goes in.
The threshold waits at the bottom of the track: a door,
cut by people who meant to come back. Everybody in this
The stations below are the same six, again, in a new
palette. That is the descent's whole grammar.
